label: CropConnect sensors
info:
Simulates the humidity and temperature sensors of each farm and publishes the readings to RabbitMQ (exchange sensors.readings, routing key farm.{farmId}.{type}).

The farms come from the API gateway (GATEWAY_URL) every minute; the broker from RABBITMQ_HOST and RABBITMQ_PORT.

name: 1. Every minute, load the active farms from the API gateway
To farms
2. Every 30 s each farm sends one humidity and one temperature reading
Simulate readings
3. Demo: make the next humidity readings too low to trigger an alert
